benefits.name: No GM Intrusion on Dodge
benefits.description: You don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1 on a dodge roll.

benefits.name: Light Melee Damage
benefits.description: You inflict +1 damage with light melee weapons.

system.description: Standing about three and a half feet (100 cm) tall, you are curious and love discovering ways to turn found things into art, tools, or weapons. You might be a sculptor, smith, artist, chef, storyteller, or inventor. Alchemy, magic, and engineering fascinate you. Other beings may see you as a strange mix of a nature-loving elf and a craft-obsessed dwarf, but you and your kind are unique people with a passion for life, exploration, and creation.
